snippet_primary: "I am writing this to warn others about Domestika's deceptive billing practices. What started as a small, one-off purchase has turned into a nightmare of unauthorized, high-value charges. In March 2025, I was charged $175 without any prior notification, renewal reminder, or receipt. Most recently, they hit my account for a staggering $361.70—a massive \"price hike\" that was also taken without consent or notice."
subject_exact: Buyer report of two undisclosed Domestika charges in 2025 (a $175 charge and a later $361.70 'price hike') with no prior notification
local_qualifiers: without any prior notification, renewal reminder, or receipt
